reports.title: Oshkosh Corporation Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Expectations
section: The Company now expects its 2026 diluted earnings per share to be between $8.00 and $9.00 and its adjusted1 earnings per share to be between $8.50 and $9.50, down between $1.50 and $2.50 from its most recent guidance. The Company now expects net sales to be approximately $11.0 billion in 2026, down $0.2 billion from its previous guidance. The Company's revised expectations reflect lower fire apparatus and NGDV production, offset in part by higher sales volume in the Access segment. The bottom end of the earnings per share range also reflects the possibility that we do not receive an NGDV order in 2026, which could impact earnings by up to $0.50 per share.
